name: Home Safety Inspection
description: Creates a room-by-room home safety inspection checklist covering fire safety, electrical hazards, carbon monoxide risks, fall prevention, water damage indicators, and child/pet safety. Includes specific testing procedures and replacement schedules for safety devices. Use when the user asks about home safety checks, wants to childproof their home, needs a safety device testing schedule, or is preparing for seasonal safety reviews. Do NOT use for structural home inspection (hire a licensed home inspector), mold testing (requires professional testing), or commercial building safety compliance.
